exact: leukemia inhibitory factor signalling pathway involved in forebrain neuron fate commitment

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of leukemia inhibitory factor to its receptor on the surface of the target cell, that contributes to the commitment of a neuroblast to a neuronal fate. The neuron will reside in the forebrain.
label: leukemia inhibitory factor signaling pathway involved in forebrain neuron fate commitment
